ns2:course.label: New Product Marketing
ns2:course.description: Exposes engineering students to the discipline of marketing and to business decision-making in the unique context of new product marketing decisions. Credit is not given for both BADM 365 and BADM 320.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Credit is not given for both BADM 365 and BADM 320.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Technology and Management major(s) or minor(s).
